name: Tominaga Yahiko
source:
A corporate slave with a large amount of magical power.

He works as a salaryman at a travel agency. In the planning department, he develops tours and other products. However, his plans have been rejected 32 times in a row. He is plump and a virgin.

His libido is above average, but he is always short on money, so he cannot dress himself well or visit prostitutes. However due to his good nature and gentle personality, he does not fall into despair and self-abandonment. He also dislikes conflict.

He possesses a large amount of innate magical power. The magical power in his semen is targeted by the demon Lyla and the angel Sylphia.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/102yojouhan/character03.html]official website[/url]]
